findings.title: Notes-strip entry contract passes a bounded clip (marquee = bounded only, scroll-x ignores vertical clip, silent-clip exempted)
findings.evidence: check_alt marquee only calls _bounded; exempt_selectors exempts marquee selectors. Probe: bounded overflow:hidden entry with scrollHeight 90 in a 20px box judges {'pass': 4, 'fail': 0} with no findings; so does ox=auto/oy=hidden with vertical clip and a 1x1 box.
findings.consequence: A phase-wbf-06 'fix' of height:20px; overflow:hidden turns the live command green while long entries remain cut off; the contract constrains only containment.
findings.minimal_fix: Require marquee to show motion (animation/transform change between samples) or reachable content; make scroll-x fail when vertical content is clipped; add minimum box sizes.

findings.title: C08 stale-selector check uses substring match and misses renames
findings.evidence: test_contract_selectors_name_classes_that_exist_in_source uses `cls in text`. Renaming stage-file-browser__tree to stage-file-browser__tree-pane across ts/src: pytest still 31 passed.
findings.consequence: File Browser tree rows (and any class that is a prefix of another) go stale with the only automated check green; the live check that would notice is not run by pytest.
findings.minimal_fix: Match the class with non-word, non-hyphen boundaries, ideally only in className strings and CSS selectors.

findings.title: R09 'suite fails when a panel violates its contract' is carried only by a manual live command that is in no gate
findings.evidence: Live half runs only via `python test/test_workbench_fit_contracts.py --live <url>`; exits 1 today (32 findings in --quick run); not collected by pytest or CI. Disclosed in REQ-037 'Boundaries and unresolved'.
findings.consequence: A regression in panel fit passes uv run pytest, CI and the phase's verification list; R09 closes only if the owner accepts a command as the suite.
findings.minimal_fix: Coordinator records that R09 closes on the command and opens a follow-up (Playwright dev dep plus server fixture, or a CI job running --live --self-test after wbf-06/13/14).

findings.title: Self-test is non-differential; notes-strip 'caught' is vacuous
findings.evidence: self_test judges only the broken cell and matches the selector in any finding. Run with --layout layout-1 --panel notes-strip --self-test prints 'caught' with the same 'not bounded by its panel' finding that exists at baseline.
findings.consequence: 'Judge named the broken region in every case' is unproven for the notes strip, the panel most at risk.
findings.minimal_fix: Judge the unbroken cell too and require a new finding on the injected region.

findings.title: Registry parser bypassed by non-literal registration
findings.evidence: Probes: `fake: makeDef('x'),`, `...EXTRA,`, `PANEL_REGISTRY['fake']=...`, Object.assign(PANEL_REGISTRY, ...) all parse OK with the fake unseen and counts agreeing.
findings.consequence: A panel registered by factory call or after the literal is neither contracted nor named by R10; C03's 'cannot pass vacuously' holds only for literal entries.
findings.minimal_fix: Reject non `key: {` entries at the literal's indent and other assignments to PANEL_REGISTRY in the file.

findings.title: C02 overstates test_undeclared_panel_fails_and_is_named
findings.evidence: The test calls assert_every_panel_declared([*ids, 'fake-panel'], contract) directly; it does not register a fake in a copy of the registry source as REQ-037 C02 states.
findings.consequence: The source-to-failure path is not covered by a single test; documentation overstates the proof.
findings.minimal_fix: Derive the ids from a mutated REGISTRY_SOURCE copy in the test, or correct the C02 wording.

findings.title: mypy errors and dead docstring in the test module
findings.evidence: uv run mypy test/test_workbench_fit_contracts.py: 6 errors (:439, :960-963); scroll_exercised docstring placed after return (:440). mypy src/ is clean and is the only CI gate.
findings.consequence: Cosmetic; the reused `key` variable is a latent bug source; 'mypy clean' holds only for src/.
findings.minimal_fix: Rename the second key, cast the bool, move the docstring.

findings.title: No minimum size on scroll, marquee, visible, wrap modes
findings.evidence: Probe: a 1x1 overflow:hidden notes-strip entry passes; wrap checks width only.
findings.consequence: A collapsed scroller, trigger or header satisfies its row.
findings.minimal_fix: Add a default minimum height/width to those modes and a wrap height-within-panel check.
